hypotheses.C1_core_channels_have_top1pct_weight_ene: Both recurrent core channels rank in the top 1% of native channel tensor energy.
hypotheses.C2_core_channels_have_top1pct_natural_wr: Both recurrent core channels rank in the top 1% of activation-weighted natural write energy.
hypotheses.C3_core_pair_is_more_causal_than_matched: Whole-sequence core-pair ablation has at least 1.5 times the mean exact KL of its activation-energy-matched pair on every corpus.
hypotheses.C4_core_effect_is_attention_mediated: Whole-sequence core-pair ablation has at least 1.5 times the mean exact KL of final-position-only ablation on every corpus.
hypotheses.C5_core_has_recurrent_simple_semantics: At least one signed current/next token-category AUROC of 0.70 or greater recurs for a core channel on all three corpora.
hypotheses.C6_core_is_more_aligned_with_leading_out: Median squared cosine with the leading output direction is higher for core channels than matched channels.
hypotheses.C7_core_pair_supports_observed_token_los: Whole-sequence core-pair ablation has positive mean observed-token CE delta on every corpus.
hypotheses.C8_core_causal_effect_exceeds_individual: Core-pair mean exact KL exceeds the sum of the two individual-channel KLs on every corpus.
